title: Pods that run a single container
description: The 'one-container-per-Pod' model is the most common Kubernetes use case; in this case, you can think of a pod as a wrapper around a single container; Kubernetes manages Pods rather than managing the containers directly.

title: Pods that run multiple containers that need to work together
description: A Pod can encapsulate an application composed of multiple co-located containers that are tightly coupled and need to share resources. These co-located containers form a single cohesive unit.
